title: Supreme Court Reviews Police Use of Cell Location Data to Find Criminals
partialText: Geofence searches allow law enforcement to find suspects and witnesses by sweeping up location data from cellphone users near crime scenes.

title: Supreme Court to Hear Arguments in Landmark Roundup Weedkiller Case

title: Cole Tomas Allen, Correspondents’ Dinner Shooting Suspect, Was Propelled by Outrage, Authorities Say
partialText: A man who has worked as a tutor and graduated from the California Institute of Technology is being held by authorities in connection with the armed attack at the White House correspondents’ dinner.

title: The War in Iran Has Upended the Global Economy. The U.S. Has Been Mostly Spared.
partialText: In just eight weeks, much of the global economy has been knocked sideways. America has mostly been spared from the tumult.

title: China’s Economy Starts to Show Cracks From Iran War
partialText: China’s strategic reserves of oil and natural gas have insulated it somewhat, but its manufacturing-based economy is beginning to falter.

title: King Charles Is Coming to the U.S. at a Very Delicate Time
partialText: Not since his mother, Queen Elizabeth II, traveled to Washington after the Suez Crisis has a visit by the British monarch come at such a fraught point in Anglo-American relations.

title: 8 Memorable Moments From Past British Royal Visits to the U.S.

title: Cellular Rejuvenation Has the Potential to Reverse Aging

title: Sergey Brin Moves to the Right, With a ‘MAGA Girlfriend’ by His Side

title: California Billionaire Tax Has Enough Signatures to Land on Ballot, Backers Say
partialText: The measure calls for placing a one-time 5 percent tax on the assets of California residents with at least $1.1 billion. Opponents are backing competing measures to counter the tax.

title: Bernie Sanders Pressures Democrats to Reject Super PAC Support in Primaries
partialText: The independent senator from Vermont says top Democrats should tell candidates they will otherwise lose access to party resources.
